node_fit.hypothesis: SQLite can power local node-run state, artifact indexes, small relational stores, and checkpoint metadata.

evidence.note: Official Git mirror is active and widely used, but GitHub release metadata is not the main release channel.

risks: GitHub release data is absent, so official SQLite release channel must be reviewed separately.

next_review_tasks: Review official SQLite website and release notes outside GitHub.
Test local artifact registry schema with SQLite.
